title: Engineering matrix-embedded dual-drug eluting biodegradable surgical sutures for prophylaxis against surgical site infections
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29478-29489
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01817C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Garba Mohammed Khalid, Neel Anil Chaudhary, Nura Hassan, Lubabah Rahman, Shahnaz Kashif, Gunjan V. Jahakar, Mouhamad Khoder
This work engineered biodegradable drug-eluting sutures via solvent-free hot-melt extrusion, enabling immediate and sustained levofloxacin and ibuprofen release to prevent surgical site infections while controlling inflammation.
